newsitem.title: CHINA: China Q1 industrial tax collection up 17.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Q1 industrial tax collection up 17.5 pct.

text.p: China collected 156.65 billion yuan ($18.87 billion) in industrial and commercial taxes in the first quarter, up 17.5 percent compared with the same year-ago period, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
Of the total taxes, the central government collected 84.702 billion yuan, up 17.7 percent year-on-year, it said. Local governments collected 71.948 billion yuan, up by 17.3 percent.
China's collection of value-added taxes and consumption taxes totalled 85.391 billion yuan in the first quarter, up 17.2 percent year-on-year, it said.
Of the total, value-added taxes were 71.054 billion yuan, up 15.1 percent and consumption taxes were 14.337 billion yuan, up 29.1 percent, it said.

Personal income tax collection was up 43.1 percent in the first quarter, income tax from Sino-foreign ventures and wholly-owned foreign firms rose 44.6 percent, it said, but did not give actual figures.

However, tax arrears by firms showed a large increase in the first quarter, it quoted officials of the State Taxation Administration as saying. Total tax arrears by industrial and commercial firms rose by 10 billion yuan in the first three months, it said. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
